title: An oasis, or a secret lair?
caption: Star trails over the Paranal Residencia, Cerro Paranal
celestial: Landscape photograph; the source does not name the site

recognition.text: ESO Picture of the Week (an editorial selection, not an audience score).

story: Star trails streak across a dark Chilean sky in this long-exposure photograph. As Earth turned during the exposure, each star traced a streak. Beneath them lies the Paranal Residencia, a refuge for staff and visitors at ESO's Very Large Telescope, high on Cerro Paranal in the Chilean desert.

Work on the Residencia began in 1998 and was finished by 2002. Since then it has given the scientists and engineers of Paranal Observatory a break from the harsh, dry desert climate. Most of the four-storey building lies underground.

German architects Auer+Weber designed it to blend with its surroundings. From some angles, the mix of high-tech, practical architecture and almost camouflaged design calls to mind a villain's hidden base. The Residencia was indeed picked to stage the final battle of the 2008 James Bond film Quantum of Solace.

understand.summary: This is a long-exposure landscape photograph of the Paranal Residencia under a starry sky. No camera settings beyond the long exposure are published.
understand.eye: The eye sees stars as points, but a long exposure records their slow movement across the sky as trails.
